text: Sab ko dhanpne wali haqeeqat Ghashiyah Qayamat ka naam hai, is liye ke woh sab par aayegi, sab ko ghere hue hogi aur har ek ko dhanp le gi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kahin ja rahe thay ke ek aurat ki Quran padhne ki aawaz aayi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade ho kar sunne lage. Usne yahi aayat "Hal ataka" padhi, yani kya tere paas dhanp lene wali Qayamat ki baat pahunchi hai? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawaban farmaya: "Na'am qad ja'ani" yani haan mere paas pahunch chuki hai. Us din bahut se log zaleel chehron wale honge, pasti un par baras rahi hogi, unke aamaal gharat ho gaye honge. Unhon ne to bade bade aamaal kiye thay, sakht takleefen uthayi thin, woh aaj bhadakti hui aag mein dakhil honge. Ek martaba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ek khanqah ke paas se guzre, wahan ke rahib ko aawaz di, woh hazir hua. Aap (R.A) use dekh kar roye, logon ne poocha Hazrat kya baat hai? To farmaya ise dekh kar yeh aayat yaad aa gayi ke ibadat aur riyazat karte hain lekin aakhir Jahannam mein jayenge. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Nasrani hain. Ikrimah aur Suddi farmate hain ke duniya mein gunahon ke kaam karte rahe aur aakhirat mein azab ki aur maar ki takleefen bardasht karenge. Yeh sakht bhadakne wali jalti tapti aag mein jayenge jahan siwaye Zaree' ke aur kuch khane ko na milega, jo aag ka darakht hai ya Jahannam ka patthar hai. Yeh thohar ki bail hai, is mein zehreelay kantay dar phal lagte hain. Yeh badtareen khana hai aur nihayat hi bura, na badan badhaye na bhook mitaye, yani na nafa pahunchaye na nuqsan door ho.

Yeh apne aamal se khush honge, jannaton ke buland bala khanon mein honge jis mein koi laghw baat kaan mein na paregi. Jaise farmaya aayat (Lā yasma‘ūna fīhā laghwan illā salāmā, wa lahum rizquhum fīhā bukratan wa ‘ashiyyā - 19. Maryam: 62) is mein siwaye salamti aur salam ke koi buri baat na sunenge aur farmaya aayat (Lā yasma‘ūna fīhā laghwan wa lā ta’thīmā, illā qīlan salāman salāmā - 56. Al-Waqi‘ah: 25, 26) na is mein fazool goi sunenge na buri baatein siwaye salam hi salam ke aur kuch na hoga. Is mein behti hui nehrein hongi, yahan nakra isbat ke siyaq mein hai, ek hi nehar murad nahin balki jins-e-nehar murad hai yani nehrein behti hongi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jannat ki nehrein mushk ke paharon aur mushk ke teelon se nikalti hain. Un mein oonche oonche buland-o-bala takht hain jin par behtareen farsh hain aur un ke paas hoorein baithi hui hain, goya yeh takht bahut oonche aur zakhamat wale hain lekin jab yeh Allah ke dost un par baithna chahenge to woh jhuk jayenge. Sharab ke bharpoor jaam idhar udhar qareene se chune hue hain, jo chahe jis qisam ka chahe jis miqdar mein chahe le le aur pee le, aur takiye ek qatar mein lage hue aur idhar udhar behtareen bistar aur farsh baqaida biche hue hain. Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein hadith hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain koi hai jo tahmad charhaye jannat ki tayari kare? Us jannat ki jis ki lambai chorai besab hai, Rabb-e-Kaaba ki qasam woh ek chamakta hua noor hai, woh ek lehlahata hua sabza hai, woh buland-o-bala mahalat hain, woh behti hui nehrein hain, woh bakasrat reshmi hullay hain, woh pake pakaye tayar umda phal hain, woh hameshangi wali jagah hai, dusra sar-e-mewa jaat sabza rahat aur nemat hai, woh tar-o-taza buland-o-bala jagah hai. Sab log bol uthe ke hum sab is ke khwahishmand hain aur is ke liye tayari karenge, farmaya Insha'Allah Ta'ala kaho. Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ne Insha'Allah Ta'ala kaha.

Kainat par gaur-o-tadabbur ki dawat. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko hukum deta hai ke woh uski makhlooqat par tadabbur ke sath nazrein dalein aur dekhein ke uski be-inteha qudrat in mein se har ek cheez se kis tarah zahir hoti hai, uski pak zaat par har ek cheez kis tarah dalalat kar rahi hai. Oont ko hi dekho ke kis ajeeb-o-ghareeb tarkeeb aur hai'at ka hai, kitna mazboot aur qawi hai aur uske bawajood kis tarah narmi aur aasani se bojh lad leta hai aur ek bachay ke sath kis tarah itaat-guzar ban kar chalta hai. Iska gosht bhi tumhare khanay mein aaye, iske baal bhi tumhare kaam aayen, iska doodh tum piyo aur tarah tarah ke faiday uthao. Oont ka haal sab se pehlay is liye bayan kiya gaya ke umooman Arab ke mulk mein aur Arabon ke paas yahi janwar tha. Hazrat Shuraih Qazi R.H farmaya karte thay, aao chalo chal kar dekhein ke oont ki paidaish kis tarah hai aur aasman ki bulandi zameen se kis tarah hai waghera. Aur jagah irshad hai, aayat: (Afala yanzuroona ilas-samai fauqahum kaifa banainaha wa zayyannaha wa ma laha min furooj) (Surah Qaf: 6).

(Surah Qaf: 6) Kya in logon ne apne upar aasman ko nahin dekha ke hum ne ise kis tarah banaya, kaise muzayyan kiya aur ek soorakh nahin chhora, phir paharon ko dekho ke kaise gaar diye gaye taake zameen hil na sake aur pahar bhi apni jagah na chhor sakein, phir is mein jo bhalai aur nafa ki cheezein paida ki hain un par bhi nazar daalo, zameen ko dekho ke kis tarah phaila kar bicha di gayi hai. Garz yahan un cheezon ka zikr kiya jo Quran ke mukhatib Arabon ke har waqt pesh-e-nazar raha karti hain. Ek badwi jo apne oont par sawar ho kar nikalta hai, zameen us ke neeche hoti hai, aasman us ke upar hota hai, pahar us ki nigahon ke samne hote hain aur oont par khud sawar hai. In baaton se Khaliq ki qudrat-e-kamilah aur sanat-e-zahirah bilkul huwayda hai aur saaf zahir hai ke Khaliq, Sani, Rabb-e-azmat-o-izzat wala Malik aur mutasarrif mabood-e-barhaq aur Allah haqiqi sirf wahi hai. Is ke siwa koi aisa nahin jis ke samne apni aajizi aur pasti ka izhar karein, jise hum hajaton ke waqt pukarein, jis ka naam doro-e-zaban banayein aur jis ke samne sar kham hon. Hazrat Zimam (R.A) ne jo sawalat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiye the woh is tarah ki qasmein de kar kiye the. Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Musnad-e-Ahmad wagaira mein hadith hai, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke hamein baar baar sawalat karne se rok diya gaya tha, toh hamari yeh khwahish rehti thi ke bahar ka koi aqalmand shakhs aaye, woh sawalat kare, hum bhi maujood hon aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani jawabat sunein. Chunancha ek din badiyanasheen aaye aur kehne lage: Ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap ke qasid hamare paas aaye aur hum se kaha aap farmate hain ke Allah ne aap ko apna Rasool banaya hai? Aap ne farmaya: Us ne sach kaha. Woh kehne laga: Batayein aasman ko kis ne paida kiya? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: Zameen kis ne paida ki? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: In paharon ko kis ne gaar diya? In se yeh faide ki cheezein kis ne paida ki? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: Pas aap ko qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne aasman-o-zameen paida kiye aur in paharon ko gaara, kya Allah ne aap ko apna Rasool bana kar bheja hai? Aap ne farmaya: Haan. Kehne lage: Aap ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke hum par raat din mein paanch namazein farz hain. Farmaya: Us ne sach kaha. Kaha: Is Allah ki aap ko qasam hai jis ne aap ko bheja ke kya yeh Allah ka hukum hai? Aap ne farmaya: Haan. Kehne lage: Aap ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha ke hamare maalon mein hum par Zakat farz hai. Farmaya: Sach hai. Phir kaha: Aap ko apne bhejne wale Allah ki qasam, kya Allah ne aap ko yeh hukum diya hai? Farmaya: Haan. Mazeed kaha ke aap ke qasid ne hum mein se taqat rakhne wale logon ko Hajj ka hukum bhi diya hai. Aap ne farmaya: Haan, us ne jo kaha sach kaha. Woh yeh sun kar yeh kehta hua chal diya ke us Allah-e-Wahid ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, na main in par kuch ziyadati karunga na in mein koi kami karunga. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Agar is ne sach kaha hai toh yeh Jannat mein dakhil hoga.

Ba'az riwayaton mein hai ke usne kaha main Dhimam bin Tha'labah hoon Banu Sa'd bin Bakr ka bhai. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein aksar yeh hadith sunaya karte the ke zamana-e-jahiliyat mein ek aurat pahar par thi, uske sath uska ek chota sa bacha tha. Yeh aurat bakriyan charaya karti thi. Uske larke ne us se pucha ke amma jaan tumhein kis ne paida kiya? Usne kaha Allah ne. Pucha mere abba ji ko kis ne paida kiya? Usne kaha Allah ne. Pucha mujhe? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha aasman ko? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha zameen ko? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha paharon ko? Bataya ke inhe bhi Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya hai. Bache ne phir sawal kiya ke achha in bakriyon ko kis ne paida kiya? Maa ne kaha inhe bhi Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya hai. Bache ke munh se be-ikhtiyar nikla ke Allah Ta'ala bari shaan wala hai. Uska dil azmat-e-Allah se bhar gaya, woh apne nafs par qabu na rakh saka aur pahar par se gir para, tukre tukre ho gaya. Ibn Dinar farmate hain Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) bhi yeh hadith hum se aksar bayan farmaya karte the. Is hadith ki sanad mein Abdullah bin Ja'far Madini za'eef hain. Imam Ali bin Madini jo unke sahibzade aur jarh-o-ta'deel ke imam hain, woh inhe yani apne walid ko za'eef batlate hain. Allah Ta'ala phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum to Allah ki risalat ki tabligh kiya karo, tumhare zimme sirf balagh hai, hisab hamare zimme hai. Aap un par musallat nahin hain, jabr karne wale nahin hain, unke dilon mein aap iman paida nahin kar sakte, aap unhein iman lane par majboor nahin kar sakte. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukm kiya gaya hai ke main logon se laron yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah kahein, jab woh ise keh lein to unhone apne jaan-o-maal mujh se bacha liye magar haq-e-Islam ke sath aur unka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki (Muslim, Tirmidhi, Musnad waghera). Phir farmata hai magar woh jo munh more aur kufr kare yani na amal kare na iman laye na iqrar kare, jaise farman hai aayat (Fala saddaqa wa la salla) (75. Al-Qiyamah: 31) na to sachai ki tasdeeq ki na namaz parhi balkeh jhutlaya aur munh pher liya, isi liye use bahut bara azab hoga. Abu Umamah Bahili Hazrat Khalid bin Yazid bin Mu'awiyah (R.A) ke paas gaye to kaha ke tum ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jo aasani se aasani wali hadith suni ho aur use mujhe suna, to aap ne farmaya main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke tum mein se har ek jannat mein jayega magar woh jo is tarah ki sarkashi kare jaise shareer oont apne malik se karta hai (Musnad Ahmad). In sab ka lotna hamari hi janib hai aur phir hum hi un se hisab lenge aur unhein badla denge, neki ka nek, badi ka bad. Surah Ghashiyah ki tafsir khatam hui.

Is ke siwa koi aisa nahin jis ke samne apni aajizi aur pasti ka izhar karein, jise hum hajaton ke waqt pukarein, jis ka naam doro-e-zaban banayein aur jis ke samne sar kham hon. Hazrat Zimam (R.A) ne jo sawalat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiye the woh is tarah ki qasmein de kar kiye the. Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Musnad-e-Ahmad wagaira mein hadith hai, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke hamein baar baar sawalat karne se rok diya gaya tha, toh hamari yeh khwahish rehti thi ke bahar ka koi aqalmand shakhs aaye, woh sawalat kare, hum bhi maujood hon aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani jawabat sunein. Chunancha ek din badiyanasheen aaye aur kehne lage: Ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap ke qasid hamare paas aaye aur hum se kaha aap farmate hain ke Allah ne aap ko apna Rasool banaya hai? Aap ne farmaya: Us ne sach kaha. Woh kehne laga: Batayein aasman ko kis ne paida kiya? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: Zameen kis ne paida ki? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: In paharon ko kis ne gaar diya? In se yeh faide ki cheezein kis ne paida ki? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Kaha: Pas aap ko qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne aasman-o-zameen paida kiye aur in paharon ko gaara, kya Allah ne aap ko apna Rasool bana kar bheja hai? Aap ne farmaya: Haan. Kehne lage: Aap ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke hum par raat din mein paanch namazein farz hain. Farmaya: Us ne sach kaha. Kaha: Is Allah ki aap ko qasam hai jis ne aap ko bheja ke kya yeh Allah ka hukum hai? Aap ne farmaya: Haan. Kehne lage: Aap ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha ke hamare maalon mein hum par Zakat farz hai. Farmaya: Sach hai. Phir kaha: Aap ko apne bhejne wale Allah ki qasam, kya Allah ne aap ko yeh hukum diya hai? Farmaya: Haan. Mazeed kaha ke aap ke qasid ne hum mein se taqat rakhne wale logon ko Hajj ka hukum bhi diya hai. Aap ne farmaya: Haan, us ne jo kaha sach kaha. Woh yeh sun kar yeh kehta hua chal diya ke us Allah-e-Wahid ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, na main in par kuch ziyadati karunga na in mein koi kami karunga. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Agar is ne sach kaha hai toh yeh Jannat mein dakhil hoga.

Ba'az riwayaton mein hai ke usne kaha main Dhimam bin Tha'labah hoon Banu Sa'd bin Bakr ka bhai. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein aksar yeh hadith sunaya karte the ke zamana-e-jahiliyat mein ek aurat pahar par thi, uske sath uska ek chota sa bacha tha. Yeh aurat bakriyan charaya karti thi. Uske larke ne us se pucha ke amma jaan tumhein kis ne paida kiya? Usne kaha Allah ne. Pucha mere abba ji ko kis ne paida kiya? Usne kaha Allah ne. Pucha mujhe? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha aasman ko? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha zameen ko? Kaha Allah ne. Pucha paharon ko? Bataya ke inhe bhi Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya hai. Bache ne phir sawal kiya ke achha in bakriyon ko kis ne paida kiya? Maa ne kaha inhe bhi Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya hai. Bache ke munh se be-ikhtiyar nikla ke Allah Ta'ala bari shaan wala hai. Uska dil azmat-e-Allah se bhar gaya, woh apne nafs par qabu na rakh saka aur pahar par se gir para, tukre tukre ho gaya. Ibn Dinar farmate hain Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) bhi yeh hadith hum se aksar bayan farmaya karte the. Is hadith ki sanad mein Abdullah bin Ja'far Madini za'eef hain. Imam Ali bin Madini jo unke sahibzade aur jarh-o-ta'deel ke imam hain, woh inhe yani apne walid ko za'eef batlate hain. Allah Ta'ala phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum to Allah ki risalat ki tabligh kiya karo, tumhare zimme sirf balagh hai, hisab hamare zimme hai. Aap un par musallat nahin hain, jabr karne wale nahin hain, unke dilon mein aap iman paida nahin kar sakte, aap unhein iman lane par majboor nahin kar sakte. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukm kiya gaya hai ke main logon se laron yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah kahein, jab woh ise keh lein to unhone apne jaan-o-maal mujh se bacha liye magar haq-e-Islam ke sath aur unka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki (Muslim, Tirmidhi, Musnad waghera). Phir farmata hai magar woh jo munh more aur kufr kare yani na amal kare na iman laye na iqrar kare, jaise farman hai aayat (Fala saddaqa wa la salla) (75. Al-Qiyamah: 31) na to sachai ki tasdeeq ki na namaz parhi balkeh jhutlaya aur munh pher liya, isi liye use bahut bara azab hoga. Abu Umamah Bahili Hazrat Khalid bin Yazid bin Mu'awiyah (R.A) ke paas gaye to kaha ke tum ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jo aasani se aasani wali hadith suni ho aur use mujhe suna, to aap ne farmaya main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke tum mein se har ek jannat mein jayega magar woh jo is tarah ki sarkashi kare jaise shareer oont apne malik se karta hai (Musnad Ahmad). In sab ka lotna hamari hi janib hai aur phir hum hi un se hisab lenge aur unhein badla denge, neki ka nek, badi ka bad. Surah Ghashiyah ki tafsir khatam hui.
